title: This AI Finds the Idea, Customers, and Does the Work

promo_conflict: The guest presents Hyper Agent, discusses its features and customer stories, and the host demonstrates using it. Most business economics come from an AI-generated research brief rather than verified operator evidence.

idea.revenue_model: not stated
